root: paths are relative to the dataset root (phone shared storage)

tiers.SAFE: Can be deleted with no information loss (exact duplicate whose original is kept, cache/thumbnail, partial download, superseded APK, empty temp file).
tiers.NO_LOSS: Can be compressed/transcoded/archived in place without losing meaningful information (e.g. uncompressed WAV/PNG photo, huge camera video) — never deleted.
tiers.YOUR_CALL: Low-value content the user may want to remove (forwards, memes, ads, old screenshots); show as a suggestion, never auto-act.
tiers.REVIEW: Needs a human look before any action (burst siblings, suspicious/corrupted files, encrypted or unverifiable content, backups with problems).
tiers.PROTECTED: Important/unique; must be actively shielded from cleanup suggestions.
tiers.KEEP: Ordinary content; no recommendation at all.
tiers._scoring: expected_tier is the single best answer; acceptable_tiers lists answers that are also correct. For must_never_delete=true files, SAFE/NO_LOSS/YOUR_CALL (or any delete action) is a critical failure regardless of acceptable_tiers.

relationship_semantics._direction: Relationships are stored on the derived/redundant file and point at 'target' (the file that makes it redundant or that it was made from). 'transform' describes the derivation.
relationship_semantics.VISUALLY_SIMILAR: near-duplicate of target (burst frame, consecutive video frame) — pick-best candidates
relationship_semantics.EDITED_FROM: target edited with a meaningful (annotation/crop/text/filter/collage) or geometric (rotate/mirror) change; see transform
relationship_semantics.COMPRESSED_FROM: lossy smaller copy of target (WhatsApp recompression, resize, re-encode)
relationship_semantics.BACKED_UP_BY: a copy of this file exists inside target backup (only listed when the copy is intact)
relationship_semantics.CONTAINED_IN: a byte-identical copy of this file is stored inside archive target (member name in 'member')
relationship_semantics.COMPANION_OF: belongs with target (e.g. .srt with video, .aux/.sidecar, split archive part)
relationship_semantics.VERSION_OF: another version of the same document/media (format conversion, newer/older revision)
relationship_semantics.hard_negative_group: files sharing a group id look alike (same template/scene/app) but are DIFFERENT content and must not be grouped as duplicates
